description: This file defines a Stateless Worker Grain class for Orleans, which produces messages to a stream. It implements the IStatelessWorkerStreamProducerGrain interface, manages stream production, and utilizes dependency injection for logging.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerStreamProducerGrain
classes.description: A Stateless Worker Grain that produces messages onto an Orleans stream, identified by a Guid streamId.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Asynchronously produces a message onto a specified Orleans stream identified by streamId, using the specified provider.
